title: OVERRUN — Dockyard Nine
summary: Defend a dockyard against escalating waves of combat synthetics.
description: A first-person horde shooter set in Dockyard Nine. Fight with an assault rifle, pump shotgun and marksman rifle; use grenades, melee attacks and explosive barrels while collecting ammunition and surviving increasingly difficult waves. The Three.js game includes a 3D industrial arena, generated textures and synthesized audio.
